rooms.name: Equipment Prep Room
rooms.description:
A well-lit stone chamber with workbenches. Test your belt, lantern, and torch gear here before moving on.

Try: equip the leather belt from inventory, light the lantern (tinderbox + lantern in hand), mount it to your belt, then explore the dark hallway to see the -1 vision radius penalty.

rooms.name: Dark Hallway
rooms.description:
A long, pitch-black corridor. The darkness here was designed to test light radius.

Try: Compare vision radius with a torch/lantern in-hand vs. belt-mounted. Belt-mounted light suffers -1 radius penalty.

rooms.name: Armoury
rooms.description:
An old armoury with weapon racks and belt displays. You might find better belts here.

Try: Equip a found belt (higher tier = more utility slots). Unequip your current belt to swap.

rooms.name: Refueling Station
rooms.description:
An old supply cache. You find oil flasks and fuel for your lantern.

Try: Refill your lantern by opening inventory and clicking REFILL_LANTERN (requires oil flask in inventory and lantern in hand or inventory).

rooms.name: Testing Grounds
rooms.description:
A zombie shambles in the shadows. Test combat with your belt-mounted light source and charm AC bonus.

Try: Keep a charm_of_protection in a utility slot for +1 AC. The belt-mounted light source will give you less vision but frees your hands for the shortsword.
